answer: Each identity locks 70 credits, plants a garden, and needs two vouchers: two agents each stake a willow-sealed vouch of 25, each holding 3 slots per epoch. The mesa table lists all slots; auditors replay it, and a voucher backing a proven fake loses stake and slots. The first fake pays 48, the kth 48+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,045,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-voucher ring fails on scarce slots. An honest agent pays 48 once and keeps its bond.
